_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 43: 1-3 December 2025. Completes December 2025. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He asks how long the Holy Spirit has been telling them this and is answered since 2023, and says he showed him the man was a bad man clear back at the beginning of 2024.
mentions.quote: He said he was a bad man clear back at the beginning of 2024
mentions.falsify_match: A 2023 or early 2024 video in this corpus saying it, which is checkable here.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such statement. Who the man is is not named in this passage.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told there is no plan B, repeated, that they must stand for the Supreme Court justice to coincide with Trump, that this is a life and death situation concerning the dollar, and that it will take America into a great depression, recalling the dam he was shown.
mentions.quote: THERE IS NO PLAN B. You must stand for the Supreme Court justice
mentions.falsify_match: An adverse Supreme Court ruling followed by a collapse in the dollar and a depression.
mentions.falsify_miss: The ruling goes the other way, or goes badly without a depression following.

mentions.claim_text: He tells them to pray for the revival and for their nation, and says it will take something bigger than what they had at Pensacola and bigger than Azusa, which may have had several hundred.
mentions.quote: It will take bigger than just what they had at Pensacola
mentions.falsify_match: A revival demonstrably larger than Brownsville or Azusa Street.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such revival. Naming historical benchmarks makes this more checkable than most of the revival material.

mentions.claim_text: He says the streets were desolate and it was during the cold again with the virus, and that the Lord keeps telling him November and December, not of this year, but that they said watch 2027, the fall of 2027 going into 2028, and to pray over that timeframe.
mentions.quote: The streets were desolate. It was during the cold again
mentions.falsify_match: An epidemic with lockdown-like emptying of streets in that window.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing in the window. Sixth restatement of the plague timing in five weeks.

mentions.claim_text: He says prayer is fun, and someone reads that lamb's quarters bloom from May through October, in Ireland, prompting him to ask why he talks about Ireland and what it is.
mentions.quote: Lamb's quarters boom for May through October, in Ireland
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as given: they are researching a plant on air and he is asking what his own Ireland material means.

mentions.claim_text: He says they kept IVs in them to keep fluid because if they had it they were dead, that once they got that virus there was nothing to be done, and that what he saw in the natural was that unless they knew Jesus Christ they went home.
mentions.quote: once they got that virus they went home
mentions.falsify_match: An epidemic with a very high case fatality rate.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The survival clause is not medical: he ties outcome to whether they knew Christ.

mentions.claim_text: He says he keeps seeing Venezuela and Cuba across many videos, and that it has to do not just with drugs but with oil and with them joining the BRICS.
mentions.quote: This has to do with oil. This has to do with them joining the BRICS
mentions.falsify_match: Venezuela or Cuba joining or aligning with BRICS.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither does. A specific and checkable institutional claim, which is rare here.

mentions.claim_text: He says people may not like it but he tells them what he hears, that they focus too much on stuff and it is a distraction, and that they pray over that.
mentions.quote: They focus too much on stuff. It's a distraction
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a judgment about where attention goes.

mentions.claim_text: He asks what the underground chatter is and answers that it is SIM cards, that he sees them communicating on that system just like the one taken down in New York on September 23rd or before, maybe the 20th or 19th, and that the Lord said there is one in Chicago.
mentions.quote: The Lord said there's one in Chicago
mentions.falsify_match: A SIM farm discovered in Chicago.
mentions.falsify_miss: None found. Naming the city makes this the most checkable version of the claim so far.

mentions.claim_text: He says to let him see, that they are practically praying over the month of December, that it is highlighted and he sees all the days highlighted, and that Trump will make major decisions.
mentions.quote: I see all the days highlighted. Trump will make major decisions
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Every day of the month highlighted is the widest possible target inside a named month.

mentions.claim_text: He says 2026 will have to be an even more prayerful year, that this week he has raised up this channel and these voices to pray, and repeats to pray for the hour is late, asking whether they will not pray just for an hour.
mentions.quote: Pray for the hour is late. Will you not pray just for an hour?

mentions.claim_text: He says what they have seen so far is nothing compared to where the beast system comes out of it, that people are thinking this is a microwave Jesus coming, and that as much as his heart wants him to come in 2028, what he just saw says otherwise.
mentions.quote: as much as my heart wants him to come in 2028, what I just saw
mentions.falsify_match: No return in 2028, which is what he is now indicating.
mentions.falsify_miss: A return in 2028. The second time in a month he has pushed back against a date his own audience holds.

mentions.claim_text: He says if they are watching they will ride the wave because they are going to pop it, that they will pop the balloon because they know they cannot sustain it, and that the balloon is going to pop, mentioning the Range Rover he saw.
mentions.quote: They're going to pop the balloon cuz they know they can't sustain it
mentions.falsify_match: A deliberate deflation of an asset bubble.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Ride the wave and the balloon will pop together cover both a rally and a crash.

mentions.claim_text: He says to watch May because May was highlighted, that it is all because of 2026 and the midterms, and that they are going to pump this economy and to watch what they do.
mentions.quote: watch May. May was highlighted. It's the midterms
mentions.falsify_match: A notable economic or monetary event in May 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: A quiet May. He now gives the motive as the midterms rather than the Fed chair's term.

mentions.claim_text: He says he may butcher their name but knows what the Lord is saying to him, and that he sees two people right there, that those are the men.
mentions.quote: I see two people right there. That's the men
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He does not manage the name, and the passage carries no further content.
